live_frontier_title: Lemma-3 perturbative stability / constant-level localization audit
current_determination: The CMP116 epsilon_1 budget is parametrically compatible with the new O(g_k) reflection-positive blocker term. The source entropy condition uses rho=gamma_2 epsilon_1^2/(20 g_k^2), hence after r=epsilon_1/g_k it depends only on r and imposes a finite lower ratio epsilon_1 >= r_* g_k. The Lemma-3/post-exponentiation smallness conditions impose an absolute upper bound epsilon_1 <= epsilon_* once the other inductive parameters are fixed. Thus for sufficiently small g_k there is a nonempty wedge r_* g_k <= epsilon_1 <= epsilon_*, and an analytic blocker perturbation C_soft g_k can fit by choosing a finite ratio r above both the source entropy threshold and the constant needed to reserve budget for C_soft. No extra power improvement from O(g_k) to O(g_k^{1+eta}) is forced by source scaling. The remaining theorem deficit is constant-level stability of the entire CMP116 localization/resummation proof under the added bounded-support analytic activity.
major_new_results: CMP116 Eq. (2.31) creates a lower comparison epsilon_1/g_k >= finite threshold, not an upper requirement epsilon_1=o(g_k).
CMP116 Lemma-3 and post-exponentiation restrictions create an absolute upper smallness bound epsilon_1 <= epsilon_*.
Therefore the source-shaped weak-coupling parameter region contains a wedge r_* g_k <= epsilon_1 <= epsilon_* for sufficiently small g_k.
The YM-R26 raw blocker term C_soft g_k is parametrically absorbable into the epsilon_1 budget; no higher coupling power is required solely by CMP116 scaling.
Rigorous closure still requires re-running all constants because the original activity already consumes part of epsilon_1.
negative_results: Do not claim the O(g_k) term is already absorbed without a constant-level reserve argument.
Do not interpret epsilon_1 as merely an arbitrary activity norm independent of g_k; CMP116 Eq. (2.31) couples it quantitatively to g_k.
Do not require an O(g_k^{1+eta}) cancellation unless a later source inequality, not yet found, imposes it.

Determine how the added term changes epsilon_2, C_3, alpha_6 allocation, the P-bond entropy estimate, and the post-Lemma-3 E_0/2 reserve.
